description: Figure 6 presents a pie chart summarizing the token resolution breakdown for the FedHLM framework, showing how tokens are distributed across three resolution stages. The chart contains three slices: “Local (Client-side)” shown as a large light-gray slice occupying approximately 94.49% of the pie, “Edge P2P Exchange” shown as a small medium-gray slice at about 1.57%, and “LLM (Cloud)” shown as a small darker-gray slice at about 3.93%. The figure does not display a separate legend, and no percentage labels are visible inside the slices; instead, the category names appear adjacent to the pie. No slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized.
